name: C++ SFML 3 Asteroids
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake ninja-build git pkg-config libx11-dev libxrandr-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev libudev-dev libfreetype-dev libharfbuzz-dev libflac-dev libogg-dev libvorbis-dev libgl1-mesa-dev libglu1-mesa-dev libegl1-mesa-dev libopenal-dev && git clone --depth 1 --branch 3.0.0 https://github.com/SFML/SFML.git /tmp/sfml && cmake -S /tmp/sfml -B /tmp/sfml/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr -DSFML_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DSFML_BUILD_TEST_SUITE=OFF && sudo cmake --build /tmp/sfml/build --target install && sudo ldconfig && rm -rf /tmp/sfml
